title: The tool registry listing and search build the index once
user_story: As the owner I want the AI tools list to answer as fast as the other AI tools requests; the 6.6.4 gate found /api/tools at about 1.3 s (agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A12).

requirements.description: listing() and search() resolve every tool against one snapshot of the index, with the same rules as resolve() (pinned versions, app compatibility).
The listed id and version of every tool equal what resolve() returns.

nonfunctional: Under 0.3 s per listing (was about 1.3 s)
postconditions: tests/test_tool_listing_664.py 3/3; RED on b440881 (59 index builds, 1.29 s)
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_tool_listing_664.py 5/5; RED on b440881 (59 index builds, 1.29 s)

scenarios.expected: One index build per listing and per search
Kind and capability filters narrow the listing
An unknown tool is still not_found with suggestions
Listing resolves with resolve()'s rules (pinned and compatible versions)

recovery: Fix at Registry._resolve_in; never cache across tool changes without invalidation. TASK-TOOL-LISTING-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable config (tests/_env.py); real registry; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/tool-listing-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 5 tests on b440881, 2 failing (59 builds; 1.29 s per listing); the equality, filter and not-found checks pass on both. GREEN: 5/5.
